usage: api_server.py [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--model MODEL]
                     [--max-model-len MAX_MODEL_LEN]
                     [--kv-cache-dtype {auto,fp8}]

vLLM OpenAI-Compatible RESTful API server.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --host HOST           host name
  --port PORT           port number
  --model MODEL         Name or path of the huggingface model to use.
  --served-model-name SERVED_MODEL_NAME [SERVED_MODEL_NAME ...]
                        The model name(s) used in the API.
  --max-model-len MAX_MODEL_LEN
                        Model context length.
  --kv-cache-dtype {auto,fp8}
                        Data type for kv cache storage.
  --gpu-memory-utilization GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION
                        The fraction of GPU memory to be used for the model
                        executor.
  --max-num-seqs MAX_NUM_SEQS
                        Maximum number of sequences per iteration.
  --max-num-batched-tokens MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS
                        Maximum number of batched tokens per iteration.
  --enforce-eager       Always use eager-mode PyTorch.
  --enable-prefix-caching
                        Enables automatic prefix caching.
  --seed SEED           Random seed for operations.
